Thanks Evan — good questions and congrats again on the demo. Short answer up front: we can get to a competitive per-1M anchor at your volume, and reserved/dedicated capacity materially lowers unit cost vs hosted bursts. I attached a one-page anchor and a spreadsheet with line items.

Highlights (high-level anchors, assuming 200M tokens / month steady):
- Redwood Hosted (recommended fast path): $85 / 1M tokens (starter anchor) — includes prefix/KV caching and standard batching policies.
- Redwood Dedicated (12mo commit, predictable capacity): $55 / 1M tokens with commit and standard SLA.
- OpenAI (managed API, high-end models): ~ $110–140 / 1M tokens (depends on model family and context length).
- Anthropic (Claude-tier analog): ~ $95–120 / 1M tokens depending on model and throughput profile.
- Open-host (self-hosted on clouds via Replicate/HF): $40–65 / 1M tokens raw compute, but add ops, availability and higher quality variance — effective total cost can creep up.

Quality/tradeoffs to call out:
- Model parity: OpenAI/Anthropic may give parity on raw quality for some tasks, but Redwood's hosting includes tuned execution, KV/prefix caching, and production optimizations so typical latency and throughput behavior is more predictable.
- Reliability & fallbacks: Redwood supports automated fallback to lighter model variants and region routing — lowers outage risk vs single-host self-managed stacks.
- Ops overhead: open-hosting reduces vendor bill but increases SRE/ops headcount and variability in tail latency.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm a most-likely monthly token baseline (we used 200M in the sheet).
2) We run a brief eval with a 1–2 week pilot (instrumented) — I can propose a pilot SOW and procurement checklist.
3) If procurement wants numbers for committed discounts, I can loop in Ben for commercial approval and a tailored reserved quote.

Would your finance lead be free for a 30-min call on Tuesday to confirm numbers?

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

3) Commercial playbook / negotiable items to offer now:
